card.name: "and" in NSAID blood pressure monitoring
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "initiation of NSAID treatment" in the NSAID hypertension warning about monitoring blood pressure. It leads into "throughout the course of therapy".

modes.label: Monitoring phrase
modes.description: "and" joining "initiation of NSAID treatment" to "throughout the course of therapy" in blood pressure monitoring advice.
modes.example: Monitor blood pressure (BP) during the initiation of NSAID treatment<< and>> throughout the course of therapy.

card.plain: It marks the "and" in the stock NSAID line about checking blood pressure at the start of treatment and throughout therapy.
